bullets.text: Prime Minister Modi visits Chennai tomorrow for development projects, prompting a five-tier security arrangement involving 22,000 police personnel; the office should monitor event logistics.
GCC Commissioner G.S. Sameeran inspected cleanliness and preparations at Mount Poonamallee High Road, Porur Metro, and IIT-Madras for the Prime Minister's visit.
Auto drivers in Periyapalayam staged a protest against the government, and the office should monitor local transport grievances in the area.
A 30-year-old youth died after being hit by a government bus near Poonamallee, and the office should watch road safety measures.
Police arrested two more suspects in Tiruttani regarding the murder case of a former cinema theater employee, and the office should track the investigation.

takeaways: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visits Chennai to inaugurate metro rail and development projects.
A five-tier security cover involving 22,000 police personnel has been deployed.
